description: Rebuild the Student Dashboard (DashboardPage.tsx) and global app shell (Sidebar, Topbar, BottomNav) to a dramatically higher visual quality. The dashboard should feel like a premium fintech/health app - with layered card surfaces, animated data visualizations, micro-interactions on every element, and a refined information hierarchy. The app shell should feel seamless, with the sidebar acting as a premium navigation experience and the topbar being minimal but powerful.
steps: Step 1: Rebuild DashboardPage.tsx - Restructure the welcome card to be a full-width gradient banner with animated particle dots, a large greeting with time-aware emoji, and a 'quick actions' row of 3-4 pill buttons (e.g., 'Continue Learning', 'Today Schedule', 'AI Assistant'). Add Links to relevant routes.

Step 2: Rebuild the GPA card - Make it a premium glass card with an animated circular gauge (using conic-gradient in CSS) showing the GPA as a ring progress. The center shows the GPA value with gradient text. Add a subtle pulse glow when the value is high (>3.5). Add a 'trend' indicator (up arrow with +0.2 text).

Step 3: Rebuild the progress doughnut section - Replace the chart.js Doughnut with a pure CSS conic-gradient ring (eliminates chart.js render flash, looks cleaner). Add animated fill on mount using CSS transitions on the conic-gradient angle. Show completed/remaining hours in a cleaner layout below the ring.

Step 4: Rebuild the term progress bar - Make it a premium segmented progress bar with milestones (small dots at 25%, 50%, 75% marks). Add animated fill with gradient and shimmer. Show current week indicator as a floating badge above the bar.

Step 5: Rebuild the agenda section - Each agenda item becomes a richer card with: icon orb with animated gradient background, better typographic hierarchy (title + subtitle + time badge), a subtle hover state that reveals a 'Join' or 'View' action button. Add stagger animation on scroll reveal.

Step 6: Add a new 'Quick Stats' row between welcome and GPA - 4 compact metric tiles showing: Courses Active, Assignments Due, Hours Studied This Week, Streak Days. Use the metric component pattern from components.css but with enhanced micro-interactions (count-up animation via CSS, hover orb glow).

Step 7: Create frontend/src/styles/redesign-dashboard.css - All dashboard reconstruction styles. Includes: animated conic-gradient GPA gauge, CSS-only progress ring for academic progress, premium agenda card styles, quick stats micro-interactions, segmented progress bar with milestone markers.

Step 8: Enhance Sidebar (frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx) - Add a collapsible state (icon-only mode for large screens). Add animated active state indicator (sliding pill that moves between items using CSS transitions on a pseudo-element). Add a 'Quick Access' section at top with 3 pinned items as icon-only buttons.

Step 9: Update frontend/src/styles/stitch-canonical.css - Refine sidebar active state to use a smooth sliding indicator pill. Refine topbar glassmorphism to be more pronounced with a gradient border-bottom on scroll. Refine bottom-nav with an animated active dot indicator.
Step 10: Add proper mobile dashboard layout in responsive.css - Quick stats goes to 2x2 grid, welcome banner shrinks gracefully, agenda items are full-width, GPA and progress cards stack vertically.
acceptance_criteria: Welcome card has quick action buttons linking to real routes
GPA visualization uses CSS conic-gradient (not chart.js for the gauge ring)
Academic progress uses CSS-only ring visualization
Term progress has milestone markers at 25/50/75%
Agenda items have stagger reveal animation
New Quick Stats row shows 4 metric tiles
Sidebar has enhanced active state with sliding indicator
All new animations have prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks
Mobile layout (480px) stacks all elements cleanly without overflow
findings: Build verification (tsc and vite build) cannot run because node_modules are not installed and the environment has a proxy-bootstrap.js module issue preventing node execution with NODE_OPTIONS. Same pre-existing environment constraint as FEAT-001. Verified via structural validation: CSS brace balance (both files balanced), TSX paren/brace balance (both OK), import presence (all required imports present), route paths (all 4 routes present), CSS import order (redesign-dashboard.css after redesign-landing.css). All acceptance criteria implemented.
